title: Thyme by the Sea Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
h1: Thyme by the Sea Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 4 houses back from the beach!!!! 250 ft from the beach!!! - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Modern home with upscale coastal decor located in OLD SEAGROVE - Quick walk to the beach- check out AERIAL photos! - 2 KING master retreats - Walking/biking distance to Seaside, shops and restaurants - Private driveway- parking for 3 cars - Two beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Grill, Outdoor Shower, Hammock and multiple spaces to sit and lounge outside - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Guests will feel at ease with the open-concept layout and chic, uncluttered décor. The living area has a 50” Smart TV and plenty of comfortable seating. The large kitchen area is completely open to the living and dining area, making it the hub of the house with an expansive counter space and bar seating for 4. The dining table seats 8 more, and a small bistro table is great for 2 more, to play cards or chess. The kitchen is truly a chef's dream, fully-equipped with anything needed to prepare a fantastic meal. Extras like a Keurig and drip coffee maker will keep everyone happy, and the spacious layout means 2 cooks in the kitchen won't be tripping over each other. Downstairs there is a bunk room which sleeps 3. There’s a TV plus a little desk in their room in case anyone has to catch up on school work. A handy half bath is located nearby. Upstairs, guests can enjoy 2 spacious king suites. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (sleeps 9) 1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Twin-over-twin bunk plus twin trundle, TV, desk area, half bath 1st Floor, Living Room: Sofa pulls out to a queen bed. 2nd Floor, Bedroom 2 : King bed, Smart TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and extra large shower. 2nd Floor, Bedroom 3 : King bed, Smart TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub, large shower. Modern and sparkling white, Thyme by the Sea is an oasis of fresh, calm vibes in Seagrove Beach! Just 400 ft from the beach access, this 3-bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home sleeps up to 9, with plenty of room for everyone to spread out, both indoors and out. Guests will be impressed at how much outdoor space they have at their disposal, whether for dinner, drinks, or family fun playing corn-hole! There is an outdoor shower, dining table and multiple seating areas with comfortable chairs and loungers. Thyme by the Sea is the perfect place to relax and enjoy your vacation. Close enough to walk or bike to everything: the beach, galleries, fine cuisine, bike trails, markets, antiques, golf, live theater, a family run book store, outdoor bazaars, and coffee shops! Just 1/3 mile walk to Seaside! BEACH ACCESS: Head down Thyme Street, cross 30A and just a few feet west you'll find your beach access, Dogwood-Thyme. Distance: 400 feet | Time: 2 minutes walking distance IMPORTANT DETAILS: * Please Note: The Carriage House, Sea Thyme, is rented separately.
